model.centralRays: Preserve axial no-bending trial and secondary-axis small lateral translation; idealization must not turn the latter into an observed exact zero or claim no refraction at all glass interfaces.
model.focusAndFocalPlane: Two principal foci; equal focal-distance magnitudes only under equal surrounding medium and the inherited thin-lens approximation. F source point versus source distance must be explicitly distinguished. Focal plane perpendicular to axis through principal focus. Reverse collimation from an axial focus is axial; from another focal-plane point, outgoing rays are mutually parallel but generally oblique.
model.source174: Converging lens with real source beyond focal distance gives finite real image; closer than focus gives virtual image from back extensions. At focus outgoing collimation is not a finite real image.
model.divergingLens: Disk-centered experiment, incident axis-parallel rays, divergent outgoing rays, backward extensions locate incident-side virtual focus. Second virtual focus for reversed incidence lies opposite at equal distance in same medium.
model.power: Retain D=1/F, explicit modern signed-focal-length convention in both languages while source distances are magnitudes. Converging positive, diverging negative; strength is |D|=1/|F|. Evaluate F in metres and D in dioptres; preserve one-metre/one-dioptre example without inventing an exercise.
